name: Beef on bamboo skewers
summary: Marinated mountain beef grilled on bamboo skewers, soft with some chew and moderately salty, scented with young bamboo and forest herbs, and eaten off the stick with basil.
origin: VnExpress, 29 May 2016, describes the third Pleiku plate after ant-salt beef and grilled chicken: mountain beef cooked on a bamboo skewer.
taste: VnExpress calls the meat soft with some chew, moderately salty, scented with young bamboo and forest herbs rather than smoke, and eaten with basil.
howToEat: Marinate the beef, thread it on bamboo, and grill over charcoal until the outside is golden and charred at the edges.
The skewer comes to the table still on the stick. Pull the meat off yourself and eat it with basil.
where: Pleiku, with a jar of wine on the table.
seoTitle: Pleiku beef grilled on bamboo skewers
seoDescription: Mountain beef on bamboo skewers, soft and lightly salty, scented with young bamboo and forest herbs. Eat it off the stick in Pleiku with basil.
